sentence_stem: Not only did the proposal fail to address the budget shortfall,
correct_completion: but it also created new legal obligations.
full_sentence: Not only did the proposal fail to address the budget shortfall, but it also created new legal obligations.
acceptable_variants: but it also imposed new legal obligations on the department.
but it also generated unexpected legal liabilities.

options.text: so the budget shortfall was resolved.
options.why_wrong: 'So' signals a result, but the fronted 'Not only' structure requires a continuation that extends the negative point, not a consequence.

options.text: yet it addressed the shortfall in full.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the stem, which already establishes that the proposal failed to address the shortfall.

options.text: but it also created new legal obligations.
because the committee had approved it.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' introduces a reason, but the stem needs an additive continuation of the inverted negative clause, not an explanation.

grammar_focus: Subject-auxiliary inversion after the fronted negative adverbial 'Not only'
explanation: After a fronted 'Not only', the auxiliary moves before the subject, and the second clause must be introduced by 'but also' to add a further, parallel point of the same negative kind.
translation: Não apenas a proposta deixou de tratar o déficit orçamentário, mas também criou novas obrigações legais.
